newsitem.title: USA: CapMAC Holdings to issue 707,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: CapMAC Holdings to issue 707,000 shrs.

text.p: CapMAC Holdings Inc said on Thursday that it will issue approximately 707,000 new shares of common stock in connection with the exercise and purchase of all of the outstanding warrants for its common stock.
The outstanding warrants had given the holders the right to purchase approximately 1.5 million shares of common stock at a price of $13.33 per share, the company said.

CapMac said it had notified the warrant holders that it would exercise its right to purchase the warrants and that in lieu of paying cash, it would issue new shares of common stock to the warrant holders.
